connector.name: Tessera MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for Tessera's LLM cost-optimization layer: anchored spend, drift, recommendations.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace io.tesseraai, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: TESSERA_API_KEY
env.description: API key in tk_* format. Get one free at https://tesseraai.io/dev.

env.name: TESSERA_UPSTREAM_API_BASE_URL
env.description: Override only for staging or local-dev testing.
